definitions.replay: Measurements at identical saved baseline poses; scene/sensor changes cannot alter the replay route.
definitions.closed_loop: All cases use one shared incomplete-map reference; the sensed controller may choose different motions.
definitions.target_opportunities: Emitted nominal pencil rays intersecting the target alone, before range gates or other opaque objects.
definitions.full_fov_opportunities: Counterfactual full-circle nominal ray grid at the same pose and mounting orientation; diagnostic only.
definitions.visible_target_echoes: Target opportunities whose nearest opaque scene hit is the target, before the range gate.
definitions.eligible_echoes: Visible nearest target hits inside inclusive min/max range gates; denominator for target-conditioned detection probability.
definitions.detected_returns: Detected returns labeled as the study target; excludes ground and all other objects.
definitions.expected_detections: Sum of independent analytical Gaussian threshold probabilities over eligible pencil-ray target echoes.
definitions.mean_power_w: Mean measured power conditional on detected target returns; threshold selection can bias this above the unconditional mean.
definitions.mean_eligible_power_w: Mean analytical noiseless power over all eligible target beams; excludes detector selection bias.
definitions.range_rmse_m: Pooled measured-minus-noise-free echo range RMS, conditional on detected study-target returns.
definitions.predicted_range_rmse_m: Square root of mean assumed range variance evaluated at each detected return's measured SNR.
definitions.observed_fraction: Fraction of common ROI XY cells containing measured endpoints; neither map accuracy nor traversable free space.
definitions.failure_prefix: All failed runs remain included; elapsed time, path and mapping describe the terminated prefix.
definitions.pairing: Seed labels and baseline pose sequences are paired. Changing beam count/geometry can change random consumption, so errors are not identical per ray.

limitations: Three seed labels are descriptive, not a population reliability estimate.
Known exact poses, ideal snapshot scans, static objects; no SLAM, rolling motion, latency or acceleration model.
Illustrative optical/material/weather coefficients; no physical-device calibration or real-weather validation.
Rain and fog add attenuation only; atmospheric backscatter and false weather returns are omitted.
Target yaw changes incidence, projected area and collision footprint together; target translation changes range and scene geometry together.
An added LOS panel is itself a real visible obstacle; closed-loop effects cannot be attributed solely to target occlusion.
Disabling LiDAR removes emissions; detection probabilities are undefined rather than zero when no eligible echoes exist.
Full-circle yaw is a geometric negative control; ray ordering may change noise assignment despite the same physical sampling directions.
Reference poses follow the baseline trajectory, including its finite endpoint; replay results measure that shared exposure, not every possible viewpoint.

cases.description: Mount pitch +15 degrees.

cases.description: Negative control: a full circle rotated by an integer azimuth step preserves physical sampling directions.

cases.description: Horizontal FOV -60 to +60 degrees; fixed one-degree angular spacing.

cases.description: Yaw offset +90 degrees with the same partial FOV as fov_front.

cases.label: Opaque occluder
cases.description: Insert a held-out opaque panel upstream of the study target; the panel also becomes a real obstacle.

cases.label: Diffuse reflectance 0.02
cases.description: Only the study target's diffuse reflectance changes; specular weight stays zero.

cases.label: Diffuse reflectance 0.85
cases.description: Only the study target's diffuse reflectance changes; specular weight stays zero.

cases.label: Target yaw: 45 degrees
cases.description: Rotate the target box 45 degrees; incidence, projected area and footprint change together.

cases.label: Target yaw: 75 degrees
cases.description: Rotate the target box 75 degrees; this is not an isolated cosine-law test.

cases.label: Target height: 0.3 m
cases.description: Reduce target height while preserving its XY footprint and ground contact.

cases.label: Target height: 2.0 m
cases.description: Increase target height while preserving its XY footprint and ground contact.

cases.label: Target x: 9 m
cases.description: Translate the held-out target along x; range, occlusion and task geometry can change.

cases.label: Target x: 13 m
cases.description: Translate the held-out target along x; inspect fixed-pose measurement traces for range effects.

cases.label: Rain: 50 mm/h
cases.description: Illustrative atmospheric attenuation from the existing rain extinction law; no rain backscatter.

cases.label: Extinction: 0.6 /m
cases.description: Illustrative extinction coefficient 0.6 per metre; no fog backscatter.

cases.label: Receiver noise: 10 times

cases.label: Azimuth samples: 90
cases.description: Four-degree instead of one-degree azimuth spacing; full-circle FOV remains fixed.

cases.label: LiDAR disabled
cases.description: Same reference and controller with no emitted scans or sensed obstacle points.
